fullTextEN: He has lots and lots of hair,
So he wants to eat something,
He is still very very hungry,

What did he eat on Tuesday,
He is still very, very hungry,
No, he is not full yet,
He is still very, very hungry,

fullTextZH: 星期四他吃了四个草莓，
fullTextEN: On Thursday, he ate four strawberries,
How many strawberries did he eat?
He is still very, very hungry,
He is still very, very hungry,
He ate a piece of cake,

fullTextZH: 所以他吃了一个棒棒糖、
因为他吃了太多太多东西，

fullTextEN: He is also very, very fat,

fullTextZH: 因为他吃了很多很多东西 ，

fullTextEN: One day he didn't eat an apple 🍎

fullTextZH: 为什么？因为他吃了绿色的叶子，
fullTextEN: Why? Because he ate green leaves.
Now he is not a caterpillar,
What about you? Are you hungry?
